description:
The Supreme Court's legal positions (правові позиції).

A position is an analyst's short statement of what the Court held, not a
quotation, filed under a classifier and linked to its source decisions. ЄДРСР
has the judgments, not which passage is the holding: for a Supreme Court
position, search here first.

Hits omit the text unless `full_text`; `position` serves it. `mark`
`indented`: the position departs from (or refines) an earlier holding;
`modified`: a later decision departed from or refined it.
`norm_refs` dates each norm it quotes to the edition then in force.

category_id.description: Classifier node; matches its whole subtree.

court_code.description: ЄДРСР court codes of the decisions a position cites, OR-ed: 9911 КГС, 9921 КАС, 9931 КЦС, 9941 ККС, 9951 Велика Палата.

full_text.description: Carry every hit's position text (off by default).

jurisdiction.description: kas, kks, kcs, kgs or vp (Grand Chamber).

q.description: Words over the position's title and text; each must occur, any order or form.

name: ua_lpd__search
title: Search Supreme Court Legal Positions
